deadline.value: Applicants are advised to apply at least four months before their proposed start date; admissions operate on a rolling basis across multiple start dates.
deadline.quote: We advise you to apply at least four months before your proposed start date. This is to allow sufficient time to review your application and undertake any additional checks.

entry_route.value: Minimum entry requirements are a 2.1 honours degree or good performance in a Master's level course in a relevant subject.
entry_route.quote:
minimum entry requirements for PhD study is a 2.1 honours degree, or equivalent, in a subject relating to your proposed area of research, or a good performance in a Masters level course in a relevant subject.
A first class honours degree (or equivalent) is usually required to be competitive for scholarship funding and a Masters degree is also a valuable asset.

supervisor.value: Applicants need to identify and contact available academic supervisors who are experts in their research topic prior to applying.
supervisor.quote: You need to identify the supervisors available to work with you. They must be experts in the topic you are interested in to ensure that your research is accurate and adding to current knowledge.

funding.value: Competition for research council scholarships and faculty awards is high and funding is competitive.
funding.quote: UK research councils: competition for these scholarships is high but the majority of your fees will be funded so it is well worth applying.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Postgraduate research programme (Computing PhD) in the School of Computing at the University of Leeds.
